requirements.requirement: On node1, new interactive login sessions use a default umask of 027.
requirements.summary: The prior interactive-login umask was 0002. A root-owned profile configuration sets 027, and fresh interactive login shells for both antrieb and root directly reported 0027 and created files/directories with modes 0640/0750. The same behavior and configuration hash were verified after reboot.

overall_summary: The task outcome is satisfied. Node1 directly demonstrated umask 027 in new interactive login shells before and after reboot. The mandatory restart protocol is complete: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged restart, observed outage, changed boot identity, and recovered system, SSH, configuration, and login behavior. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the reboot.
limitations: Package-manager consistency checks timed out in both lifecycle snapshots, so package health was not independently assessed; no package-changing executor command was observed (global:before_prepare:node1:package-health, global:after_executor:node1:package-health).

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The retained profile file was required for the outcome; temporary verification files and directories were bounded and removed; and the reboot was required by the provider-wide evidence protocol. Post-executor observations show no failed services, unexpected exposure, or abandoned temporary test artifacts. Listener differences are only post-reboot PID changes.
